head: 66e63f9d
summary: Built the .NET 10 walking skeleton with 110 registered operations, replaceable endpoint groups, portable JSON validation/errors, SSE support, hermetic controls and fail-closed access seams. Whole-solution build and format pass; 141 fast tests pass with the persisted CPython 3.12 oracle. All twelve fresh socket replay reports cover 1769 exchanges; framework is 29/39 (74.36%) without waivers. Deferred business/gateway groups remain red by design. Removed the halt and supplied architecture, ownership, board and improvements reports. The head identifies the implementation commit; the finish commit contains only the final log/status.

deviations.what: Created the mandatory skeleton reports, log, improvements and status under dotnet/docs.
deviations.why: The conductor's explicit resume instruction requires these outputs and supersedes the original documentation ownership conflict; no unrelated path was changed.

deviations.what: Provided both improvements/W1-skeleton.json and improvements/skeleton.json with identical entries.
deviations.why: The prompt names both files. Stage 4 is the primary register, the fixed-rule name is a compatibility copy, and a test prevents drift.

deviations.what: Retained native routing, explicit-origin CORS and self-contained documentation instead of matching incidental framework recordings.
deviations.why: The pre-approved policy forbids reproduction of framework artifacts. These remain visible raw misses; the framework threshold passes without any waiver.

deviations.what: Implemented all eleven captured workspace routes, not the ten mentioned in the scope prose.
deviations.why: The authoritative inventory includes eleven operations; dropping one would violate the complete operation surface.

findings: F-6: missing workspace assumptions were plain-text 500; the host returns dependency-unavailable JSON 503.
F-4: negative proximity bands now return validation JSON 422 instead of an unhandled 500.
F-3: client identifiers outside Int64 storage range now return validation JSON 422.
F-1: absolute simulation magnitude above 10000 is refused with JSON 422 before computation.
Native trailing/case routing, explicit CORS and local documentation intentionally differ from incidental Python framework output.
The unchanged replay posts an empty reset object; the wrapper selects the scenario profile through the reset URL.
Relative raw-report paths could fail after the child changed directory and reuse stale reports. Absolute paths, prior-report removal and two focused tests now prevent false success.
Real persistence seeding, JWT verification, business handlers and data-dependent P2 readiness counters are deferred adapters, not fabricated skeleton functionality.
Slow parity assertions are unchanged; the fast test-run envelope fell from the unclassified 19m12s parity baseline to 8.997s across all four populated test projects.

needs_human.item: M-01: review ingestion overrides of year-resolved wage_basis, measuring_date and pay codes.
needs_human.why: ADR-005's year-resolved precedence conflicts with the captured behavior. Changing it moves calculated figures, so the certified port remains unchanged pending the owner decision.

needs_human.item: Review credit_math pricing the first program when a state has several programs.
needs_human.why: The pre-approved policy preserves this figure-affecting behavior. Typed run-resolution refusals remain where already ported; no new credit_math refusal was added.

needs_human.item: Review the operational simulation magnitude ceiling of 10000.
needs_human.why: F-1 requires a bound but specifies no threshold. The chosen ceiling refuses runaway input without introducing statute or changing a calculated figure.
